interface.signature: findSwapValues(A: List[int], B: List[int], N: int, M: int) -> int

preconditions.description: The size of array A is between 1 and 10^6.
The size of array B is between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if any(a - b == (sum(A) - sum(B)) / 2 for a in A for b in B) else return_value == -1
postconditions.description: The function returns 1 if there exists a pair (a from A, b from B) such that swapping a and b makes the sums of A and B equal, otherwise returns -1.
